assumptions: No leverage; no short selling; weights sum to 100%.
Monthly strategic optimization; test windows are unseen by their optimizer.
Long Treasury is an explicitly labeled duration/yield proxy, not a canonical total-return index.
Rule-based regimes are diagnostic labels, not objectively discovered states.

SP500.instrument: SP500 price index + Shiller dividend series
SP500.notes: Monthly total return uses Shiller price and trailing dividend; daily dividend is apportioned across trading days.

GOLD.source: Yahoo Finance GC=F daily futures proxy; datasets/gold-prices monthly source
GOLD.notes: USD gold price proxy; daily series is GC=F futures and monthly series is the gold-price dataset; no storage, insurance, or ETF fee adjustment.

LONG_TREASURY.notes: Not a canonical bond total-return index. Approximation uses duration=18, daily yield changes, and carry.

CASH.notes: Risk-free cash leg compounds the observed annualized 3-month T-bill rate between observations.

missing_data.notes: The common panel is an inner join. No missing observations are silently forward-filled across assets.

robustness.formula: weighted sum of normalized OOS risk-adjusted return, drawdown, CVaR, turnover, window stability, and regime stability components; coefficients sum to 1.0 by default.

regimes.feature_notes: Trailing equity/gold/bond momentum and equity volatility; label is shifted one month before performance attribution.

data_quality.notes: The common panel is an inner join. No missing observations are silently forward-filled across assets.
